review.decision: Keep each provider skill identity within its own recorded schema
review.notes: Read full S review and verify bytes/SHA. DSH current rc.5 declares name, OpenCode V2 id does not authorize DSH id. For exact DSH skill, any id field is an unknown alias conflict and remains neutral, including mixed name/id; original skill compatibility and all existing invalid/conflict controls stay. OpenCode name/id, DSH name and queries are unchanged. No source/FS inference, original input/ref/redaction/dedup/count behavior changes. Actual native DSH adapter output is supplied to Chat/Trace plus rendered RN row; exact S production overlay must fail the new target assertions while legitimate controls remain green. No live provider/app input.
